message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  While exact figures vary by source, the generally accepted totals are:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| French & allied (Bourbon & German) | **≈ 25 000** |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | **≈ 22 000** |

**Total combined casualties:** roughly **47 000** soldiers.

These numbers include those killed, wounded, and taken prisoner or otherwise rendered unfit for further service.  The French suffered the largest loss, partly because they launched several costly frontal assaults on the Allied lines.
